title: A delegation result read by a session other than its parent answers a bare 404 "delegation not found" without naming the supported route
outcome: When a session asks termal_get_session_result for a delegation it did not spawn, the refusal says that delegation results are scoped to their parent session. For an acceptance evaluation, it also names the durable record that any session in the project can read (engram show of the evaluation id), instead of a bare 404 that reads like the delegation does not exist.
acceptance: A delegation result read by a session other than its parent answers a bare 404 "delegation not found" without naming the supported route is done
